시편-67-1.title: 시편 67장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-67-1.exegesis: 16-20. With these he unites his public thanks, inviting those who fear God ( Psa 60:4 ; 61:5 , His true worshippers) to hear. He vindicates his sincerity, inasmuch as God would not hear hypocrites, but had heard him.
시편-67-1.theologicalNote: 16-20. With these he unites his public thanks, inviting those who fear God ( Psa 60:4 ; 61:5 , His true worshippers) to hear. He vindicates his sincerity, inasmuch as God would not hear hypocrites, but had heard him.

시편-67-2.title: 시편 67장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-67-2.exegesis: PSALM 67 Psa 67:1-7 . A prayer that, by God's blessing on His people, His salvation and praise may be extended over the earth. 1. cause his face to shine-- show us favor ( Nu 6:24 , 25 ; Psa 31:16 ).
시편-67-2.theologicalNote: PSALM 67 Psa 67:1-7 . A prayer that, by God's blessing on His people, His salvation and praise may be extended over the earth. 1. cause his face to shine-- show us favor ( Nu 6:24 , 25 ; Psa 31:16 ).

시편-67-3.title: 시편 67장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-67-3.exegesis: 2. thy way-- of gracious dealing ( Is 55:8 ), as explained by-- saving health-- or literally, "salvation."
